meta.title: DeepSeek web chat
meta.description: A right-sidebar chat panel for DeepSeek Harness. Open the right sidebar and choose "DeepSeek 对话" to start. Multi-session chat with streaming, deep thinking, web search, attachments, voice input/read-aloud and OCR; switch between DeepSeek official, Harness-configured models, iFlytek Spark and your own OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Type a drawing request (e.g. "画一只猫" / "draw a cat") to generate images inline via a configured image service (Qwen, Volcano, SiliconFlow, Tencent Hunyuan/TokenHub or a custom endpoint), with a gallery, large-image viewer and edit derivation. Includes per-reply token/TPS/cache stats, auto context compaction, conversation export (Markdown/text/PNG), history ZIP import/export, personalization, custom background, scheduled automation, app connectors (GitHub/Gmail/Outlook/QQ) and an animated desk pet. API keys are stored in Harness credentials, never in the browser; chat and image requests are sent to the providers you configure. Turning the plugin off removes the panel and stops its background automation.
